title: Wall mount for iPad 11-inch (portrait)
summary: A screw-on cradle the iPad stands in, with the middle left open for a USB-C charging cable, plus two turn clips that hold the top edge.
notes: Sized for a bare iPad 11-inch (A16): 248.6 × 179.5 × 7.0 mm. An iPad Air or Pro 11 fits too, a case does not. Needs 5 countersunk wood screws, 4 mm: 3 for the cradle, hidden behind the iPad, and 1 per clip. One print: cradle and both clips.
